task: set connector tool policies for members
definition: As an admin, restrict which tools on an allowed connector members can invoke.
outcome: an already-allowed connector exposes only the admin-selected subset of its tools to members, and tools outside the policy cannot be invoked

records.outcome: the tenant's consent for the connector covers the write permission set (mail, calendar, mailbox settings, file writes), so write tools can be used
preconditions: The tenant's existing consent covers only read permissions
Microsoft Entra Global Administrator or Application Administrator role
steps: Open Enterprise applications in the Microsoft Entra admin center
Approve the updated permission set covering mail, calendar, mailbox settings, and file writes

evidence.quote: If your tenant's consent for the connector covers only read permissions, a Microsoft Entra Global Administrator or Application Administrator approves the updated permission set

records.notes: One-time action per tenant; first of the two places write actions are controlled.

records.outcome: write actions are on for all users, or for specific users via role-based access control, so members can invoke the connector's write tools
preconditions: Write actions are currently off for the organization
steps: Turn write actions on for all users
Alternatively, enable write actions for specific users with role-based access control (beta)

evidence.quote: administrators turn them on for all users in the Microsoft 365 connector configuration, or enable them for specific users with role-based access control (beta)

records.notes: Second of the two places write actions are controlled; the page does not name the configuration screen's location.

records.outcome: the local connector requests exactly the listed delegated Graph scopes at the next sign-in, changing which read and search tools are exposed to users
preconditions: whatever is listed must also be consented on the app registration from step 1
steps: List the delegated scopes you want in the entry's scope field
Add any of the optional read scopes needed for the extra tools
Consent the same scopes on the app registration in Entra and keep the two lists in sync

evidence.quote: To request a different set, list scopes in the entry's `scope` field.

records.notes: User.Read and offline_access are always included. An unrecognized scope name rejects the whole entry at configuration load and the connector does not appear.

records.outcome: the write tools matching the granted scopes appear on the local connector so Claude can act in Microsoft 365, each still requiring user approval on every call
preconditions: Claude Desktop 1.19367.0 or later; 1.24012.0 or later for the Teams write tools
steps: Add the desired write scopes to the entry's scope field
Consent the same write scopes on the app registration from step 1
Optionally adjust per-tool approval with toolPolicy, noting that allow resolves to ask for the send tools

evidence.quote: grant write scopes: add them to the entry's `scope` field and consent them on the app registration from step 1

records.notes: Granting a subset of the write scopes exposes a matching subset of the tools; removing them returns the connector to read-only.
